_about: Walter De la Mare. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Collected Poems; Memoirs of a Midget. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

mare-collected-poems-1901-1918: Collected Poems 1901-1918 in Two Volumes. Volume I.

mare-collected-poems-1901-1918.case: Bloom lists de la Mare's Collected Poems. The 1920 Collected Poems 1901-1918 is US-PD and on PG.
mare-collected-poems-1901-1918.note: The Veil (1921, PG 52366) postdates the collection and is also PD; anything after 1930 is not.

mare-memoirs-midget.evidence: PG header read; full novel (870 KB); PG's '[Adapter]' role tag is a cataloguing slip.
mare-memoirs-midget.case: Bloom lists Memoirs of a Midget (1921). PG text of the 1922 Knopf edition.
